name: residential_age_groups
description: Test 10: state 12 with one histogram bucket b = 3 (age 30), ageCount 200, ageEqSum 10000 (average EQ 50). The population is 0, so 0x2A5E7009 = 0 first. For each age group g the shipped curve 0xEA540621 + g is read at 21 + 3b = 30 (the spec's n values imply 6, 24, 27, 20, 12, 7, 4, 0, 0 percent); n = trunc((curve x float(200)) x 0.01f) with the product rounded to float32 before the truncation (1200 x 0.01f = 12.0, not 11.99999973 -> 11): 12, 48, 54, 40, 24, 14, 8, 0, 0 (0xCA545CAB + g). The group EQ is trunc(n x 50) / n = 50 for g = 0..6 and 0 for the empty groups 7 and 8 (0xCA545CCA + g). The series are interleaved per g, population first.
